profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Transitioned out of the United States Marine Corps after four years of honorable service.  I served as an administrative specialist in charge of a multitude of tasks ranging from managing accounts of well over 750 members, communicating to different departments around the world, and leading/managing projects.  Though-out my time working as the project lead for multiple assignments I have developed skills that have become invaluable in the work place. 

I was a student at the Microsoft Software & Systems Academy (MSSA) as a Software Developer.  This course was challenging with the goal of establishing an advanced overview of development fundamentals and procedures such as in Structured Query Language (SQL), coding in C#, ASP.NET Web applications, and Azure Application Development.

I currently work as a Software Engineer at Microsoft.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Full-stack web development of the Microsoft Store for Business (SfB).  

• Learned and successfully enabled telemetry for Microsoft’s Home Use Program which enabled the team a better more fluent experience that customers will enjoy.
• Works using SQL, C# back end development, and Angular/Typescript for front end development.
• Compliance Champion, ensuring that our teams' multiple services meet compliance regulations prior to inspections.
• Diversity and Inclusion Champion, tasked with helping to cultivate positive professional relationships for a more unified Microsoft.
• Microsoft Software and Systems Academy mentor, providing transitioning service members and veterans with critical career skills required for today’s growing technology industry.
• Part of the Incident Management group that helps to mitigate real-time incidents impacting our customers to ensure speedy recovery of affected services.
• Use the DevOps model to ensure continuous integration and deployments for the different services we provide.

positions.title: Microsoft Software and Systems Academy (Student)
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Obtained the Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA 98-361) certification for Software Development Fundamentals as prerequisite for an 18-week technical program developed by Microsoft. The curriculum leverages college accredited courses and the goal of preparing transitioning service members for technical opportunities at Microsoft and their Enterprise Partners.

• Earned 15 credit hours toward a Technical Management degree.
• Designed, composed, and built cloud applications.
• Implemented user interfaces using Model-View-Controller architecture.
• Administered organizational databases to provide end users with multimedia services.
• Automated interaction for multimedia devices, mobile computing, and information services.
• Learned conceptual frameworks to position, license, brand, and make apps available as products.
• Learned the essentials of Developing Windows Apps including their layout, user interface, structure, display, and style templates.
• Creating a personal project using C# programming language to develop a medical program inspired by new innovated technology using drones to carry medical equipment.

positions.title: Senior Administration Project Manager
positions.description:
Performed supervisory duties as mid-level office manager in a variety of administrative assignments.  Capabilities in Marine Corps standard word processing and database software packages, and the Marine Corps Total Force System (MCTFS), which encompasses the On-line Diary System (OLDS), and the Defense Travel Systems (DTS).

•	Line Supervisor-hand-picked to demonstrate proper procedure and ensure Marines stayed focused, driven, and on task.
•	Tracked over 800+ members Debt and Claims cases ranging from $200.00 to $200,000.00 and ensured business related travel customers' problems were corrected.
•	Assigned to track and maintain personnel accountability for over 750 staff.
•	Tasked with analyzing, correcting, and presenting over 1000+ certificate/medals of recognition to members that displayed tremendous work ethic.
•	Diverse in different aspects such as operating a tactical armored vehicle worth over $220,000 through hazardous terrain without incident.
•	Directed the preparation of the section through two companywide inspections resulting a near perfect score of 97% in which was recognized in the form of an award from the company senior manager.

positions.title: Administration Specialist
positions.description:
Administrative Specialists are required to learn administrative procedures and processes, pay and personnel information, preparation of orders and directives, correspondence, communication skills and the use and maintenance of filing systems. 

•	Developed and implemented a plan that successfully transitioned the Mail Distribution Center to personnel without missing a delivery.
•	Coordinated and published the daily report calendars along with the tasking trackers with excellent accuracy.
•	Volunteered in the community and unit resulting in a commendatory certificate from the director of the agency.
•	Safe and effectively trained 60 employees in the proper handling and usage of perilous material.
•	Supported the company with over 40 service members in the administrative legal actions required for separation from the agency.

honors.title: Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal
honors.description: Meritorious service while serving as the administrative non-commissioned officer in charge, 5th battalion, 11th Marine regiment, 1st Marine division from November 2013 to March 2017.  Throughout this dynamic and demanding period, Christopher Reyes distinguished himself as a superior non-commissioned officer and leader of marines.  Displaying superb professionalism and initiative by significantly enhancing the efficiency and operational capacity of the battalion administrative section.  His leadership, noteworthy inventiveness and astute managerial skill in the performance of his duties noticeably improved the effectiveness of the section.  Achieving full compliance mission capable findings during two commanding generals’ inspections, and a positive impact throughout the command. Christopher Reyes’ ability to succeed and set a positive example for his peers was evident by his selection as non-commissioned officer of the quarter at the battery, battalion and regimental levels, and his meritorious promotion to rank of both corporal and sergeant.  Christopher Reyes’ initiative, perseverance, and total dedication to duty reflected credit upon him and were in keeping with the highest traditions of the Marine Corps and the United States Naval Service.
honors.issuer: Issued by United States Marine Corps · Mar 2017

honors.title: Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal
honors.description: Professional achievement as administrative specialist, 5th battalion, 11th Marine regiment, 1st Marine division, from 4 January to 24 March 2016.  During this period, Christopher Reyes performed his duties in an exemplary and professional manner.  Instrumental to the administrative section’s efforts in preparing for the 2016 commanding generals’ inspection.  As the lead for three functional areas Christopher Reyes worked countless hours conducting internal inspections that ensured the highest level of preparation.  Testament to his hard work and attention to detail, Christopher Reyes took charge and assessed his section’s administrative readiness and implemented a plan that generated a progressive approach of preparation for all functional areas.  Christopher Reyes’ leadership and initiative set him apart from his peers and earned him the highest respect of his superiors.  Christopher Reyes’ exceptional professionalism, unrelenting perseverance, and loyal devotion to duty reflected credit upon him and upheld the highest traditions of the Marine Corps and the United States Naval Service.
honors.issuer: Issued by United States Marine Corps · Apr 2016
